capacity_sensitivity.method: Current catalog charged once per unique identity; canonical/history/dictionary charged conservatively per acquisition. ZIP indexing keeps all source-version volume as a conservative sensitivity, without assuming proportional savings from duplicate IDs. SQLite search uses distinct additional identities. CSV count remains P5 size-based estimate. No statistical confidence interval. History/content dedup and graph tail cardinalities remain unknown. Existing maintenance/safety absolute reservations are not reduced.

unmodelled_graph_tail.note: Sample-density sensitivity, not a measured full-graph closure bound. Work filters are retained.

unverified_filenames_extreme.note: All ZIP members treated as separate works and no SQLite overlap. Excludes extra CSV uncertainty; not an absolute bound. Main scenarios assume filename candidates are valid.
